font_policy: All manuscript figure headings, panel labels, axis labels, tick labels, legends and data annotations must use Times New Roman.
caption_policy: Scientific captions and explanatory text belong in LaTeX, not inside the figure.
readability_rule: Text must remain legible after the figure is scaled to its intended LaTeX column or text width.
panel_density_rule: Use only the number of panels required to convey the scientific result; avoid crowded grids.
earlier_qc_figures: May remain as historical QC artifacts. Regenerate under this style if selected for the final manuscript.
